en:
Really...? Seems like you'd have a lot
of men vying for your attention.

Hmm, actually, it feels like most of the
guys who talk to me already have girlfriends.

But, I'll wait patiently for my wonderful prince.
Maybe there's one closer than I think?
You never know.

Originally I did it to save money for
acting classes, since I want to be an actress.

I've learned a lot from this job about how to
talk and convey the right emotions, though.
So it's like taking a class all day long.

Except I actually get paid at night, so maybe
these classes are better! Kidding, of course! <symbol=note_with_outline>

Hey, you can't just decide that!
But that's just your style, huh? So silly.
I like a lot of different genres.
Oh yeah? Then...
How about rock?

I've been listening to more rock than anything
lately! I went to a festival last summer. It was so fun!
How about classical?

I want to get more into classical music,
but whenever I try, I just fall right asleep.
How about enka?

I don't know too much about it, but I've got
some customers who are really into it.
I like the song, "Pure Love In Kamurocho."

Back in the day,
that was one of my go-to karaoke songs.

Really!? Talk about a coincidence!
We should do a duet of it sometime. <symbol=note_with_outline>
And we're gonna keep having more fun!
I'm just happy you're having fun, Kiryu-san. <symbol=note_with_outline>

I'm having fun, too! I wish this never had to
end... Just kidding.
Yeah. I actually like the cold, though.

You can layer your clothes,
and you have more options for outfits. <symbol=note_with_outline>

I see. That's the kind of logic only
a girl could have.

But it's no different for men!
How about I coordinate an outfit for you?
I like the suit I've got on, so I'm good.
Awww, too bad.
I think the taste improves with you around, too.

You're drunk, aren't you, Kiryu-san?
Tell me again when you're sober. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

A-Are you okay, Kiryu-san!?
Were there some weird mushrooms in the food...!?

Well, that's polite. Hello, Kiryu-san. <symbol=note_with_outline>
This is kind of awkward.
Really? If you want to do some touching... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
...Then go to a different club.
You're quite handsome, too!
You mean it? Thanks. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Wh-What's gotten in you?

Uh, I was just thinking about
how beautiful your eyes are.

I just wasn't expecting you to break out
in English all of a sudden. You're silly.
Come on, I bet you say that to every girl.
If you agree to only look at me, then sure.
Think you can only request me from now on...?
That's fine.

Really?
Then, maybe I'll only look at you, too. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Oh c'mon, don't you know
you're the only one I look at?
You'd better only look at me too, okay?

I don't have a boyfriend or
anyone I like right now.
Oh, you don't?

I do think it'd be nice, though.
But first I have to work hard at my job!
Hmm... It's a secret.
That just makes me even more curious...

Well, it's embarrassing! I mean,
there is someone I'm a bit interested in...
You don't mean me, do you?
And what if I did? <symbol=note_with_outline>
There's... someone, I guess?

But I'm sure it's unrequited. He seems dense,
and it might be hard to make it work out...

He's dense?
He doesn't know what he's missing.

That's the first I've actually heard a line like
that! Kiryu-san, you're silly.

Then I think I'm about to get some
second-degree burns... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
I'm ready for you any time!
I don't actually eat out in Kamurocho very often.

I'm a big eater,
so it actually costs a lot if I go out to eat...
Must be rough...

Yeah. At least I can make all I want at home.
It's made me a better cook.
Wow, that's pretty amazing.

Then I should cook for you sometime,
Kiryu-san. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Kiryu-san, you go to places like that?
That's kind of surprising.

Hmm... I'd rather you didn't
go to those kind of places...
Oh? Why's that?

Well, I don't know of too many girls who'd want
a guy they like to be in those places.

Wait, what am I saying...?
N-Never mind!

Huh? You destroyed a convenience store? 
How does something like that even happen!?
It's kind of complicated...
I guess... Just don't destroy our club, okay?
Yeah. It'll be fine... probably.

Kiryu-san... If you have something you need
to confess, I'll listen.

Just know that if it's something I can't forgive,
you might find yourself in a bucket of hot water.

That's a pretty old expression...
You sure you aren't lying about your age?
Was he a friend of yours?

Yeah. He was like a brother to me. Even now, I find
myself thinking back to when we just messed around.

Oh, I see.
What kind of memories do you have of him?

We sang karaoke together a lot. There was a
popular band at the time that we really liked.

He was the type to hog the mic, so most of the
time he forced me to sing back-up for him.

Wow. Singing together like that...
Sounds like you two were really close.

Yeah. But now I can never do
those dumb interjections again...

Ah, sorry.
I shouldn't have brought up something so dark.

No... You can talk about whatever
you want if it helps ease your burden.

We used to just drink and shoot the breeze
at this bar we really loved.

Sounds like you two made a lot
of memories at this bar.

Yeah. Even now, when I walk by it, I feel like
I could go in and he'd still be sitting there.

Pretty stupid, right?
I know he's gone, but...

A lot happened...
And in the end, it had to come to blows.

More and more... I wonder if there was
some way things could have ended better.

Someone you can share your secrets with, I guess?
I just want a friend before I find a true friend...

Ohh, I could see that!
I bet you're good at taking care of someone!
Is that how I look?

Yeah. Any baby would be thrilled to be lifted
into the air in your arms! You'd be a good dad.

You know so much about it! You should let
me taste some of the fish you catch.

Huh? How does one even become a target of
an organization like that?
Good question...

Maybe that's just the card fate dealt you.
But I'm on your side, okay?

Honestly, you have to wonder what's going on
in the minds of people like that.

I used to go all the time! Pocket Circuit
Stadium, right? My machine was pretty fast.
Wow. Never imagined you were into it.

Oh yeah! Have you heard, Kiryu-san? About the
guy called "The Fastest Man in Kamurocho?"

He's a legend who'd show up whenever there was a
Pocket Circuit boom, win every race, then disappear.
If it comes back again, maybe he'll reappear...

I've even heard rumors that he took one of
the Pocket Circuit staffers as his wife...
H-Huh... There were rumors like that?
(Is she talking about me? Couldn't be...)

But Kiryu-san, you seem pretty strong already.
You're still training?

Strength has no ceiling.
I'm going to keep aiming higher.

Then I hope you'll be there to help me out
if I ever find myself in a pinch.
Sure. Leave it to me.
That's encouraging. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Me too. I'm no good in a crowd.
Huh!? I would have thought the opposite!

I tend to like people who take the lead, but...
if it was you, I wouldn't mind you being passive.
Thanks for the support...

You never gave me that impression, Kiryu-san.
I can talk to pretty much anybody!
Oh? Any tips you can share?

Just smiling and nodding go a long way.
You should give it a shot, Kiryu-san!
Smiling and nodding, huh?

Well... There's nothing wrong with being shy
either, so you don't have to force it...

I don't worry about that stuff... Of course,
I'd be happy if you took me somewhere like that.
Oh, you would?

For me, the company is more important than the
venue. If I like him, I'm fine going anywhere.
Hmm... Around 48?

That's right. I didn't think you'd
get it on the dot, though...

Wow, I nailed it!
How old do I look?
Hmm. 18?

Nope. I'm actually 23! But it's great that you
knew guessing low was the safest bet with a woman.
Nah, I just said what I thought.
Thank you. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Hmm. 23?

Oh! You're right! I'm impressed.
Good job, Kiryu-san!
Hmm. 28?
Kiryu-san... Better luck next time.
I was wrong? Sorry...

Geez. I'm still 23.
Do I look that old?

No, I was just misled by the refined
charm you have about you.

Nice save.
I'll let you off the hook this time. <symbol=note_with_outline>

I think you're a fun customer!
Time flies when I'm with you, Kiryu-san.
I'm having fun, too.

You're a special customer.
I get all happy whenever you walk in.
It's nice to hear that.
I'm always waiting for you. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Y-You're... someone I'm interested in, I guess.

Sometimes I find myself wondering
what you're doing... Oh, what am I saying!?

I see... I came to this club because
I was interested in you, too.
Kiryu-san...! I'm glad, though. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

I have no preference when it comes to age. Even
a guy as old as my dad could be in the strike zone.
So... I have a chance, then.

Of course! Guys in your age range are actually
the sexiest. I bet you're popular with the girls.

I have a finger fetish.
I love a man with long, rugged fingers...!
Yeah? What do you think about mine?

They're actually really my type!
I've been stealing glances at them... <symbol=note_with_outline>

I'd like a home theater system. I want to watch
movies on a big screen with powerful sound!

I met my first love at a class reunion the
other day, but now he's the father of two kids.
Well, a lot can happen by that age.
How did your first love go, Kiryu-san?
Me? I...

L-Let's just drink the night away then,
Kiryu-san!

We went to a bread factory on a field trip.
I think that was my first real job experience.
Uh, not that kind of first time.
Huh? What do you mean, then?
Er, never mind...

Kiryu-san, that's sexual harassment.
I'm not telling you.
What? Well, what color do you think they are...?
Hm, let's see... White?
Then they're white. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Oh, Kiryu-san. You're such a perv... I'll tell
you, but... it's a secret, okay?
...They're black.

I'd like to get married sooner than later.
I want kids.
Think you'll ever settle down, Kiryu-san?
Hmm. I have things I need to do before then.

If you keep putting it off, all the cute girls
are going to get snatched up, though. Like me.
I'll have to be careful about that.

Um... What about you, Kiryu-san?
Do you think you... want to get married?

I've got a lot going on right now. But part
of me would like that to happen some day.
Oh, really!? I'm glad.
Hm? Why's that?
...It's nothing.
Really? I don't actually wear that much makeup.

Oh, also, you probably shouldn't say that
to a woman.

They might take it as you think they're ugly
without their make-up on.

I meant it as a compliment...
A woman's mind is so complex.
Huh? You think we've seen each other somewhere?
I feel like I saw you at a movie theater...

Oh, I go to the theater a lot, so it might have
been me! Let me know next time you go, would you? <symbol=note_with_outline>
Was that you I saw fishing on the pier?

No, I wasn't there.
Probably wasn't me...
I thought so... Sorry.
Did we meet in a previous life?

Kiryu-san, I didn't know you were capable of
anything that cheesy. I wasn't expecting that!

...But, maybe we did. I feel like maybe
fate guided us here.

Thank you! My figure is the one thing
I'm confident about. Even though I'm a big eater.

I'm amazed you can keep a body like that despite
how much you eat. Do you do anything special?

Not really. In fact, it makes the other girls
kind of jealous of me sometimes...
Having a good figure is a crime, huh?

Some people say that cheating
is a sign of a successful man.
Would you forgive me?

Not in a million years! Would you forgive your
girlfriend if she cheated on you?

Well, if she cheated, it might have been my
fault anyway, so... I might forgive her.

Wow, you're very open-minded about it, Kiryu-san.
I wouldn't be able to forgive them.

I'd never forgive her.
I'd curse her descendants.

True, true, true!
Cheaters should burn in the fires of hell! Yep.

Good. If we dated, I wouldn't
have to worry about you cheating on me...

Oh, I like going outdoors too!
What kinds of places do you go, Kiryu-san?
It's got to be the ocean.

I love the ocean! Yakisoba, fried squid,
and shaved ice! I love them all!
Um... Is eating all you think about?

Eating something at the beach makes it way more
tasty! That's the joy of the outdoors for you.
